title: Mandeali language - Omniglot
text: Mandeali (मंडयाल़ी) Mandeali is a member of the North-Western branch of the Western Pahari group of Indo-Aryan languages. It is spoken by about 623,000 people in northern India, particularly in the city of Mandi in the Mandi district of central Himachal Pradesh state. It is considered by UNESCO as definitely endangered, as relatively few children are learning it.
